name: US equity stress
summary: VIX 21.6 on 16 Nov, above the 20 Watch line, as tech selling pushed the S&P 500 4.7% below its high
state: The VIX rose to about 21.6 on 16 Nov, above the 20 Watch line, as US stocks fell for a second session (Yahoo Finance). The S&P 500 traded near 7,455 intraday, 4.7% below its 52-week high and just inside the 5% drawdown line. Selling centred on technology and crypto-linked shares before Nvidia's results, with the 10-year Treasury yield at about 5.15% (Motley Fool). No circuit breaker or VIX reading above 30 was found.
for_you: Holders of US equities and tech-heavy funds, including through pensions, are exposed to further swings while volatility is above its normal range. Rising bond yields add pressure on share valuations.
rubric_hit: VIX 21.6 in 20–30 Watch band; S&P 500 drawdown 4.7%, under the 5% line

sources.title: Motley Fool — Stock Market Midday, Nov. 16: Nasdaq tumbles as Wall Street braces for Nvidia earnings

why: The S&P 500 is the world's risk barometer; sharp falls and spiking volatility transmit to pensions, credit and confidence globally.
drivers: Earnings, interest-rate expectations, liquidity, geopolitical shocks, positioning and leverage.

rubric.alert: VIX > 30, or drawdown > 15%, or a market-wide circuit breaker trips.
rubric.normal: VIX < 20 and S&P 500 drawdown from 52-week high < 5%.
